statements.statement: The member was diagnosed with R00.2 (unexplained dyspnea)
The member was diagnosed with R42 (syncope)
The member presented with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial evaluation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered
